name: COMP101_L3_ControlStructures

relation_semantics.dependsOn: Pedagogical prerequisite: understanding/performing the subject requires the object to already be known. Direction: if A dependsOn B, B is learned first. In this module A-Box uses Skill→Skill and Concept→Concept only (OWL domain/range are owl:Thing). Concept→Concept dependsOn is intentional for teaching order / conceptual prerequisites (including 'part of the idea' prerequisites like Function Interface→Parameter style chains). Do NOT reject Concept→dependsOn→Concept as a type error, and do NOT rewrite it to usesConcept or partOf.
relation_semantics.isRequiredBy: Inverse of dependsOn (OWL). A-Box is forward-only (dependsOn); do not expect asserted isRequiredBy triples.
relation_semantics.usesConcept: Subject relies on object Concept in a load-bearing teaching sense. OWL domain = union of Skill, Algorithm, LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, Method; range = Concept. This module's A-Box uses Skill→Concept and Algorithm→Concept heavily — BOTH are valid. Skills deliberately use usesConcept here (legacy; not requiresConcept). Algorithms use usesConcept to name concepts they illustrate. Do NOT flag Algorithm→usesConcept or Skill→usesConcept as subject-type errors. Do NOT rewrite usesConcept→Concept edges into usesConstruct (different range: ConceptCarrier).
relation_semantics.isUsedBy: Inverse of usesConcept (OWL). Domain Concept; range = same union as usesConcept domain. A-Box is forward-only.
relation_semantics.implementedBy: Concept is realized/expressed by a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Concept, range=ConceptCarrier. A-Box: Concept→LanguageConstruct / Operator / DataType. Domain is Concept only — never Algorithm (algorithms use usesConstruct for carriers). Multiple carriers per concept are normal.
relation_semantics.implementsConcept: Inverse of implementedBy (OWL). A-Box asserts only implementedBy.
relation_semantics.usesConstruct: Algorithm is coded with / employs a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct, Operator, BuiltInFunction, or DataType). OWL: domain=Algorithm, range=ConceptCarrier. Distinct from usesConcept (→Concept) and from implementedBy (Concept→carrier). Never propose usesConstruct with a Concept object.
relation_semantics.constructUsedBy: Inverse of usesConstruct (OWL). A-Box asserts only usesConstruct.
relation_semantics.acceptsType: BuiltInFunction accepts values of the object DataType as an argument/input. OWL: domain=BuiltInFunction, range=DataType. Comment: 'A function accepts this data type as input' means values OF that type (e.g. len() accepts str values; int() accepts str values for conversion) — NOT 'accepts the type object itself', and NOT operatesOnType (that property is Operator→DataType only). Multiple acceptsType edges from one function are a union of accepted input types and are fine.
relation_semantics.acceptedBy: Inverse of acceptsType (OWL). A-Box asserts only acceptsType.
relation_semantics.operatesOnType: Operator works on values of the object DataType. OWL: domain=Operator, range=DataType. Never use for BuiltInFunction subjects (those use acceptsType / producesType).
relation_semantics.operatedOnBy: Inverse of operatesOnType (OWL). A-Box asserts only operatesOnType.
relation_semantics.producesType: Subject yields/returns a value of the object DataType. OWL domain is owl:Thing, range=DataType; this module's A-Box is BuiltInFunction→DataType (e.g. range()→range, len()→int). Matching the modelled return type is enough.
relation_semantics.isProducedBy: Inverse of producesType (OWL). A-Box asserts only producesType.
relation_semantics.throwsError: Subject is associated with an ErrorType that can arise from incorrect use in this course. OWL: domain=owl:Thing, range=ErrorType; comment allows language construct, function, method, OR concept. This module's A-Box includes LanguageConstruct→ErrorType, BuiltInFunction→ErrorType, and Concept→ErrorType — Concept subjects are allowed when the ontology links a taught concept to a typical error. Range must remain ErrorType (never retarget to another Concept).
relation_semantics.isThrownBy: Inverse of throwsError (OWL). A-Box asserts only throwsError.
relation_semantics.methodOf: Method belongs to / is callable on the object DataType. OWL: domain=Method, range=DataType. Unused in this lecture's A-Box.
relation_semantics.hasMethods: Inverse of methodOf (OWL). Unused in A-Box.
relation_semantics.contrastsWith: Two entities that are alternatives, opposites, or commonly confused and should be distinguished. OWL domain/range owl:Thing; this module's A-Box is Concept↔Concept only. Not a prerequisite (dependsOn) and not a usesConcept link.
relation_semantics.taughtIn: Entity is introduced or explicitly taught in the object Lecture. OWL: domain=Thing, range=Lecture. External-evidence gated for the judge.
relation_semantics.teaches: Inverse of taughtIn (OWL). A-Box asserts only taughtIn.

competency_questions.question: Which concepts does 'Control Program Execution' (SK_CTRL01) use?
What does 'Evaluate Boolean Conditions' (SK_CTRL02) depend on?
Which concepts are taught in L03?
Which ConceptCarriers implement the Iteration concept (C_CTRL04)?
Which constructs do control-structure algorithms use (usesConstruct)?
Which operators operate on a data type (operatesOnType)?
Which errors can be thrown in the control-structures ontology?
Which builtins accept a data type (acceptsType)?

authoring_policy: Lecture 3 (Control Structures). Edge roles (match OWL + A-Box): (1) dependsOn = Skill→Skill or Concept→Concept prerequisites — allowed; do not convert to usesConcept. (2) usesConcept subjects = Skill OR Algorithm (also allowed by OWL: LanguageConstruct/Operator/BuiltInFunction/Method) → Concept; Algorithms illustrating concepts via usesConcept are intentional. (3) usesConstruct = Algorithm → ConceptCarrier only (def/for/while/print/…). (4) implementedBy = Concept → ConceptCarrier only — never Algorithm. (5) acceptsType = BuiltInFunction → DataType (values of that type as inputs; not operatesOnType). (6) operatesOnType = Operator → DataType only. (7) throwsError range = ErrorType; Concept subjects are allowed by OWL comment/A-Box. Never 'fix' a usesConcept→Concept edge by changing it to usesConstruct.
